name: llm-lab
description: Local LLM lab devcontainer template — generates full agentic setup with features, GPU bridge, bifrost, models, and opencode agents.

GPU_MODE.description: WSL2 GPU bridge mode (wsl2), native Linux GPU (native), or no GPU (none)

MODEL.description: Model to fetch and run (IQ2_M variant only for v1)

MODELS.description: JSON array of model specs [{name,provider,hf,quant,port,context,parallel}, ...] to serve simultaneously (multi-upstream). Empty = default single-model (gemma4-26b-a4b). Overrides MODEL.

ROLES.description: JSON object mapping agent role -> {model, slot} across the MODELS. Empty = default 8-role mapping onto the first model.

FEATURES_TAG.description: Version tag for the feature collection (ghcr.io namespace)
